name: Welcome to PixelDeck
description: A hands-on tour: one feature per slide, from panoramas and layers to formats, localization and export.
author: PixelDeck

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
This project is a hands-on tour.
Each slide explains one feature.

en.text:
This project is a hands-on tour.
Each slide explains one feature.

es.text:
Este proyecto es una visita guiada.
Cada diapositiva explica una función.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Click anything. Move it. Edit it.
It is yours to break.

en.text:
Click anything. Move it. Edit it.
It is yours to break.

es.text:
Haz clic en lo que quieras. Muévelo.
Edítalo. Puedes romperlo sin miedo.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Open the next slide in the
SLIDES strip at the bottom.

en.text:
Open the next slide in the
SLIDES strip at the bottom.

es.text:
Abre la siguiente diapositiva en la
tira SLIDES de la parte inferior.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
A pano is one wide canvas that
exports as 2 or 3 screenshots.

en.text:
A pano is one wide canvas that
exports as 2 or 3 screenshots.

es.text:
Un pano es un lienzo ancho que se
exporta como 2 o 3 capturas.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Whatever crosses the dashed seam
continues on the next screenshot.

en.text:
Whatever crosses the dashed seam
continues on the next screenshot.

es.text:
Lo que cruza la línea discontinua
continúa en la captura siguiente.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Each half is saved as its own PNG,
so the set flows in the store.

en.text:
Each half is saved as its own PNG,
so the set flows in the store.

es.text:
Cada mitad se guarda como un PNG
propio y el conjunto fluye en la tienda.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Use ×2 or ×3 in SLIDES to
make any slide a pano.

en.text:
Use ×2 or ×3 in SLIDES to
make any slide a pano.

es.text:
Usa ×2 o ×3 en SLIDES para
convertir una en pano.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Drag the phone or a photo
across the dashed seam.

en.text:
Drag the phone or a photo
across the dashed seam.

es.text:
Arrastra el móvil o una foto
al otro lado de la línea.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
A slide is a stack of layers. There
are 8 types, and here is one of each.

en.text:
A slide is a stack of layers. There
are 8 types, and here is one of each.

es.text:
Una diapositiva es una pila de capas.
Hay 8 tipos; aquí tienes uno de cada.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Select a layer here or in the LAYERS
panel, then edit it in PROPERTIES.

en.text:
Select a layer here or in the LAYERS
panel, then edit it in PROPERTIES.

es.text:
Selecciona una capa aquí o en el panel
LAYERS y edítala en PROPERTIES.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
One text box can mix weights, colors
and gradients. Select a few words
and restyle only those.

en.text:
One text box can mix weights, colors
and gradients. Select a few words
and restyle only those.

es.text:
Una caja de texto mezcla grosores,
colores y degradados. Selecciona
unas palabras y cambia solo esas.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Brand Kit colors are linked, not
copied: change one and every layer
using it updates.

en.text:
Brand Kit colors are linked, not
copied: change one and every layer
using it updates.

es.text:
Los colores del Brand Kit están
enlazados, no copiados: cambia uno
y se actualiza en todas las capas.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Open Brand Kit (top bar) and change
“Accent”. All four pieces follow.

en.text:
Open Brand Kit (top bar) and change
“Accent”. All four pieces follow.

es.text:
Abre Brand Kit (barra superior) y cambia
«Accent». Las cuatro piezas le siguen.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Base is your master canvas. You
design here. It is never exported.

en.text:
Base is your master canvas. You
design here. It is never exported.

es.text:
Base es tu lienzo maestro. Diseñas
aquí. Nunca se exporta.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
iPhone and Android are formats: the
exact sizes each store asks for.

en.text:
iPhone and Android are formats: the
exact sizes each store asks for.

es.text:
iPhone y Android son formatos: los
tamaños exactos que pide cada tienda.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
Every format scales itself from Base,
so you only design once.

en.text:
Every format scales itself from Base,
so you only design once.

es.text:
Cada formato se escala solo desde
Base: solo diseñas una vez.

layers.name: Body 4
layers.text:
The + next to the tabs adds more:
iPad, Watch, Mac, TV or a custom size.

en.text:
The + next to the tabs adds more:
iPad, Watch, Mac, TV or a custom size.

es.text:
El + junto a las pestañas añade más:
iPad, Watch, Mac, TV o tamaño propio.

layers.name: Note text You are on BASE · 1290 × 2796
Note text You are on iPHONE · 1320 × 2868
Note text You are on ANDROID · 1080 × 1920
Try it
layers.text:
Click the iPhone and Android tabs
above the canvas. Watch the pill.

en.text:
Click the iPhone and Android tabs
above the canvas. Watch the pill.

es.text:
Pulsa las pestañas iPhone y Android
sobre el lienzo. Fíjate en la etiqueta.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Move or resize a layer while a format
tab is active and the change is
pinned to that format only.

en.text:
Move or resize a layer while a format
tab is active and the change is
pinned to that format only.

es.text:
Mueve o redimensiona una capa con
una pestaña de formato activa y el
cambio queda fijado a ese formato.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Base and the other formats stay put.
Text, colors and images stay shared.

en.text:
Base and the other formats stay put.
Text, colors and images stay shared.

es.text:
Base y los demás formatos no cambian.
Texto, colores e imágenes se comparten.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
An amber frame means you are
editing one format.

en.text:
An amber frame means you are
editing one format.

es.text:
Un marco ámbar indica que editas
un solo formato.

layers.name: Base note
layers.text:
On Base and iPhone this
phone sits on the left.

en.text:
On Base and iPhone this
phone sits on the left.

es.text:
En Base y en iPhone este
móvil está a la izquierda.

layers.name: Android note
layers.text:
On Android it is pinned
to the right, and bigger.

en.text:
On Android it is pinned
to the right, and bigger.

es.text:
En Android está fijado a
la derecha y es mayor.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
On Android, drag the phone. Back on
Base it has not moved. “Reset format
layout” undoes it.

en.text:
On Android, drag the phone. Back on
Base it has not moved. “Reset format
layout” undoes it.

es.text:
En Android, arrastra el móvil. En Base
no se ha movido. «Reset format
layout» lo deshace.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
A locale is a language version of
your project. One is the Default:
the source the others start from.

en.text:
A locale is a language version of
your project. One is the Default:
the source the others start from.

es.text:
Un locale es una versión de tu
proyecto en un idioma. Uno es el
Default: la fuente de los demás.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
This tour has English (Default) and
Spanish. Switch, and the text and the
screenshot change together.

en.text:
This tour has English (Default) and
Spanish. Switch, and the text and the
screenshot change together.

es.text:
Esta visita tiene inglés (Default) y
español. Cambia, y el texto y la
captura cambian a la vez.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Click “Spanish” in the locale tabs,
right of the format tabs.

en.text:
Click “Spanish” in the locale tabs,
right of the format tabs.

es.text:
Pulsa «Default» en las pestañas de
idioma, junto a las de formato.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Localization (top right) is a table:
one row per text, one column per
language.

en.text:
Localization (top right) is a table:
one row per text, one column per
language.

es.text:
Localization (arriba a la derecha)
es una tabla: una fila por texto y
una columna por idioma.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Type or paste translations, or let
AI translate with your own API key.

en.text:
Type or paste translations, or let
AI translate with your own API key.

es.text:
Escribe o pega traducciones, o deja
que la IA traduzca con tu clave API.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
Phones and images can use a
different file per language too.

en.text:
Phones and images can use a
different file per language too.

es.text:
Los móviles y las imágenes pueden
usar un archivo distinto por idioma.

layers.name: Body 4
layers.text:
On the canvas you edit the Default
text. Other languages are edited
in Localization.

en.text:
On the canvas you edit the Default
text. Other languages are edited
in Localization.

es.text:
En el lienzo editas el texto Default.
Los demás idiomas se editan en
Localization.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Open Localization and change
a Spanish cell.

en.text:
Open Localization and change
a Spanish cell.

es.text:
Abre Localization y cambia una
celda de Spanish.

Ajusta el diseño
para cada idioma

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Translations run longer. Resize or
move a layer for one language and
the others do not change.

en.text:
Translations run longer. Resize or
move a layer for one language and
the others do not change.

es.text:
Las traducciones ocupan más. Cambia
una capa para un solo idioma y los
demás no cambian.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
On Base + Spanish, the tweak follows
Spanish into every format.

en.text:
On Base + Spanish, the tweak follows
Spanish into every format.

es.text:
En Base + Spanish, el ajuste sigue
al español en todos los formatos.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
On Android + Spanish, it applies
to that pairing only.

en.text:
On Android + Spanish, it applies
to that pairing only.

es.text:
En Android + Spanish, se aplica
solo a esa combinación.

layers.name: Body 4
layers.text: Formats pin. Locales adjust on top.

en.text: Formats pin. Locales adjust on top.

es.text: El formato fija. El idioma ajusta.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
Switch to Spanish: this headline is
12% smaller there, and only there.

en.text:
Switch to Spanish: this headline is
12% smaller there, and only there.

es.text:
Vuelve a Default: allí este titular
es más grande. El ajuste es solo aquí.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Templates (top bar) has ready-made
sets for the most popular app types.

en.text:
Templates (top bar) has ready-made
sets for the most popular app types.

es.text:
Templates (barra superior) trae
conjuntos listos para apps populares.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
Use one as a new project, then drop
your own screenshots on the phones.

en.text:
Use one as a new project, then drop
your own screenshots on the phones.

es.text:
Úsalo como proyecto nuevo y suelta
tus capturas sobre los móviles.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
Assets (left) holds your images.
Drag one onto the canvas, or select
a phone and click the image.

en.text:
Assets (left) holds your images.
Drag one onto the canvas, or select
a phone and click the image.

es.text:
Assets (izquierda) guarda tus
imágenes. Arrastra una al lienzo, o
selecciona un móvil y haz clic en ella.

layers.name: Title
layers.text:
Export it all
in one click

en.text:
Export it all
in one click

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
Export renders every locale ×
format × slide as its own PNG.

en.text:
Export renders every locale ×
format × slide as its own PNG.

es.text:
Export genera un PNG por cada
idioma × formato × diapositiva.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
This tour: 2 languages × 2 formats
× 13 screenshots = 52 files.

en.text:
This tour: 2 languages × 2 formats
× 13 screenshots = 52 files.

es.text:
Esta visita: 2 idiomas × 2 formatos
× 13 capturas = 52 archivos.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
Base is not exported. A pano is split
into one PNG per screenshot.

en.text:
Base is not exported. A pano is split
into one PNG per screenshot.

es.text:
Base no se exporta. Un pano se divide
en un PNG por captura.

layers.name: Body 4
layers.text:
Download a ZIP, pick a folder, or
automate it with the CLI.

en.text:
Download a ZIP, pick a folder, or
automate it with the CLI.

es.text:
Descarga un ZIP, elige una carpeta
o automatízalo con la CLI.

layers.name: Body 1
layers.text:
1  Projects → New project starts
     from a blank canvas.

en.text:
1  Projects → New project starts
     from a blank canvas.

es.text:
1  Projects → New project empieza
     con un lienzo en blanco.

layers.name: Body 2
layers.text:
2  Templates → Use template starts
     from a finished design.

en.text:
2  Templates → Use template starts
     from a finished design.

es.text:
2  Templates → Use template parte
     de un diseño terminado.

layers.name: Body 3
layers.text:
3  Help (top right) covers every
     panel and shortcut.

en.text:
3  Help (top right) covers every
     panel and shortcut.

es.text:
3  Help (arriba a la derecha)
     explica cada panel y atajo.

layers.name: Try it
layers.text:
This tour is a normal project.
Keep it, or delete it in Projects.

en.text:
This tour is a normal project.
Keep it, or delete it in Projects.

es.text:
Esta visita es un proyecto normal.
Consérvala o bórrala en Projects.
